2608.02189.title: Disentangled Contrastive Learning for Zero-Shot Multilingual Dense Retrieval
2608.02189.paper_summary: Multilingual dense retrieval aims to handle queries and documents across different languages based on a unified retriever model. The challenge lies in enabling robust retrieval transfer to low-resource languages where annotated retrieval data is often scarce. Although previous studies transfer high-resource supervision to low-resource languages in multilingual semantic representation learning, the shared representation often entangles semantic and linguistic features, which may interfere with optimizing semantic relevance for retrieval. Different from existing methods that focus on learning language-agnostic semantic features under such entanglement, we propose a disentangled contrastive learning~(DCL) method for multilingual dense retrieval by separating multilingual representations into semantic and linguistic subspaces. Specifically, we design disentangled optimization objectives based on hierarchical semantic alignment and language debiasing contrastive learning. By aligning retrieval-relevant semantics across languages at both sentence and token levels while capturing language-specific variations in the linguistic subspace, these objectives reduce language-induced interference in semantic matching. We jointly optimize them with the retrieval objective to facilitate stable zero-shot transfer from English supervision to multilingual dense retrieval. Extensive experiments on mMARCO and MIRACL show that our method consistently outperforms several strong baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness and generalization ability.
2608.02189.paper_summary_zh: 多語言密集檢索旨在基於統一的檢索模型處理不同語言的查詢和文檔。挑戰在於使低資源語言的檢索轉移穩健，因為這些語言的標註檢索數據往往稀缺。儘管以往的研究將高資源的監督轉移到低資源語言中進行多語言語義表示學習，但共享的表示往往糾纏了語義和語言特徵，這可能會干擾檢索的語義相關性優化。與現有方法不同，這些方法專注於在此類糾纏下學習與語言無關的語義特徵，我們提出了一種解糾纏對比學習（DCL）方法，通過將多語言表示分離為語義和語言子空間來進行多語言密集檢索。具體而言，我們基於分層語義對齊和語言去偏見對比學習設計了解糾纏的優化目標。通過在句子和標記層面對齊檢索相關的語義，同時捕捉語言特定的變化，這些目標減少了語言引起的語義匹配干擾。我們與檢索目標共同優化它們，以促進從英語監督到多語言密集檢索的穩定零樣本轉移。在mMARCO和MIRACL上的廣泛實驗表明，我們的方法始終超越幾個強基線，證明了其有效性和泛化能力。
